select_AttnForwardMethod_MLA: select AttnForwardMethod.MLA to use absorbed multi-latent attention for efficient inference
select_AttnForwardMethod_MHA: select AttnForwardMethod.MHA to use standard multi-head attention
select_AttnForwardMethod_MHA_CHUNKED_KV: select AttnForwardMethod.MHA_CHUNKED_KV to chunk KV cache and avoid OOM on long prefixes
select_AttnForwardMethod_MLA_FUSED_ROPE_: select AttnForwardMethod.MLA_FUSED_ROPE_CPU to use MLA with fused RoPE kernel for CPU
select_AttnForwardMethod_DSA_NPU: select AttnForwardMethod.DSA_NPU to use Deepseek V3.2 sparse multi-latent attention for NPU
